$comment: Open-source registries for distance recovery. All entries are public open data (ODbL / MIT / Government Open Data License-India). Licences and caveats are recorded per source; nothing here is authoritative railway chainage.

station_reference.name: india_railway_stations
station_reference.description: Geo-referenced list of Indian Railway stations (code, name, lat, lon, state, zone).
station_reference.license: Public domain / community (gist); verify provenance before production use
station_reference.caveats: Community-maintained; station codes may lag or contain transcription errors. Used only as a geocoding reference, never as authoritative chainage.

rail_network.name: india_railway_network_vmap
rail_network.description: Simplified operational railway line network of India (MultiLineStrings, ~2k features).
rail_network.license: Public domain / community (gist); derive from VMAP-type source
rail_network.caveats: Low-resolution network; vertex spacing is coarse so along-line distances are estimates. Good for station-to-station rail-distance estimation; too coarse for curvature/gradient.

rail_network_osm.name: hotosm_ind_railways
rail_network_osm.description: OSM railway export of India (monthly, from Humanitarian Data Exchange). Higher fidelity than the VMAP network; supports curvature/gradient derivation later.
rail_network_osm.caveats: 91 MB uncompressed; quality varies by region; used as an upgrade path for the map-matcher, not the default (default = gist network for speed).

timetable_distances.name: Indian-Railways-Data schedules
timetable_distances.description: Per-train station sequences with cumulative km from starting station (2858 trains). Used ONLY as validation ground-truth for station-pair rail distances.
timetable_distances.caveats: Distances are cumulative timetable km (not chainage) and may differ slightly from track-chart chainage; suitable as an independent cross-check, not a replacement.
